description:
ABOUT THIS POSITION 
 
Waystar is seeking a hands-on Data and Artificial Intelligence Security Engineer to join our Security Operations team. This role will help build and operate the technical controls that protect sensitive enterprise data and enable the secure adoption of artificial intelligence. 
The ideal candidate will have experience implementing enterprise data protection technologies, including Microsoft Purview and data loss prevention solutions, along with a practical understanding of modern AI systems. This position will work closely with Security Operations, Data and Engineering, IT, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and application teams to translate security requirements into effective and scalable controls. 
 
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Data Protection Engineering 
 Implement and manage Microsoft Purview capabilities, including data discovery, classification, sensitivity labeling, data loss prevention, and other applicable data security controls. 
 Deploy and operate Cyberhaven or similar data security platforms, including policy development, data lineage, sensitive data detection, enforcement, and alert tuning. 
 Develop an integrated control model across Purview, Cyberhaven, cloud platforms, identity, endpoint security, and security monitoring. 
 Identify sensitive data exposure and improve protection across endpoints, Microsoft 365, cloud, SaaS, and AI services. 
 AI Security Engineering 
 Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for AI applications, models, data pipelines, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, model APIs, and Model Context Protocol integrations. 
 Evaluate risks including prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, excessive agency, insecure tool use, unauthorized model access, and third-party AI dependencies. 
 Define security requirements and guardrails for enterprise AI systems and approved AI services. 
 Develop and perform security testing for AI applications, integrations, and agent workflows. 
 Monitoring and Response 
 Integrate data and AI security telemetry into existing Security Operations monitoring and response processes. 
 Develop alerts, investigation procedures, and response playbooks for data loss and AI-related security events. 
 Investigate potential data exposure, policy violations, unauthorized AI use, and anomalous data movement. 
 Measure control effectiveness and continuously tune policies to reduce risk without creating unnecessary business disruption. 
 Governance and Enablement 
 Support AI intake, risk assessment, exception, and review processes with technical analysis and control recommendations. 
 Translate regulatory, privacy, and security requirements into enforceable technical controls. 
 Develop standards and guidance for secure data handling and AI adoption. 
 Educate technical and business stakeholders on data protection and AI security practices. 
 
 
 
 
 
 WHAT YOU'LL NEED 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 4+ years of experience in security engineering, including hands-on experience with data security, data loss prevention, or information protection. 
 Experience configuring and managing Microsoft Purview or comparable enterprise data protection technologies. 
 Experience with data classification, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, policy enforcement, and data exposure investigation. 
 Working knowledge of generative AI technologies, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, model APIs, and AI integrations. 
 Experience with security architecture reviews, risk assessments, or threat modeling. 
 Ability to communicate technical risks and recommendations to engineering teams, business stakeholders, and leadership. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Hands-on experience with Cyberhaven or a comparable data detection and response platform. 
 Experience with Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management, or Data Security Posture Management. 
 Familiarity with AI security risks and frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and MITRE ATLAS. 
 Experience integrating security telemetry with SIEM and Security Operations workflows. 
 Experience with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform and their native data security capabilities. 
 PowerShell, Python, or other security automation experience. 
 Experience protecting healthcare or other regulated data, including PHI, PII, and PCI data. 
 Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft security certifications, or equivalent practical experience. 
 
 
 ABOUT WAYSTAR 
 
 Through a smart platform and better experience, Waystar helps providers simplify healthcare payments and yield powerful results throughout the complete revenue cycle.
 Waystar’s healthcare payments platform combines innovative, cloud-based technology, robust data, and unparalleled client support to streamline workflows and improve financials so providers can focus on what matters most: their patients and communities. Waystar is trusted by 1M+ providers, 1K+ hospitals and health systems, and is connected to over 5K commercial and Medicaid/Medicare payers.  We are deeply committed to living out our organizational values: honesty; kindness; passion; curiosity; fanatical focus; best work, always; making it happen; and joyful, optimistic & fun.
 
 Waystar products have won multiple Best in KLAS® or Category Leader awards since 2010 and earned multiple #1 rankings from Black Book™ surveys since 2012. The Waystar platform supports more than 500,000 providers, 1,000 health systems and hospitals, and 5,000 payers and health plans. For more information, visit waystar.com   or follow @Waystar   on Twitter.    

 
 
 WAYSTAR PERKS 
 Competitive total rewards (base salary + bonus, if applicable)
 Customizable benefits package (3 medical plans with Health Saving Account company match)
 We offer generous paid time off for our non-exempt team members, starting with 3 weeks + 13 paid holidays, including 2 personal floating holidays. We also offer flexible time off for our exempt team members + 13 paid holidays 
 Paid parental leave (including maternity + paternity leave)
 Education assistance opportunities and free LinkedIn Learning access
 Free mental health and family planning programs, including adoption assistance and fertility support
 401(K) program with company match
 Pet insurance
 Employee resource groups
 
 
 Waystar is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate, value, and support diversity and inclusion. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, marital status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
 This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
